description:
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping any land you control.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Heirophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
